tests_required: fixture: feed a known mesh/animation file name to the 0x005508A0-equivalent loader and assert return 0 and a populated output struct (flags/scale/dimension/name plus block arrays).
negative: a nonexistent file name returns -1 and reports the Could not locate mesh file %s message.
short-read: a truncated file handed to 0x00550AD0 returns -1 and frees dword_8B8F30/dword_8B8F34.

material vs texture path: flags bit 2 (material) and bit 1 (texture/animation) allocate the expected array shapes (12-byte descriptors with 36-byte elements vs 44-byte descriptors with 32-byte frames).
0x00543FA0 reset: a second call frees the previous arrays (counts cleared) before reallocating from current bucket counts.
0x0053CE10 flag: after a successful load obj+0x114 bit 3 is set; after a loader failure it is untouched.
